question.text: SEBI's risk management framework for equity derivatives includes:

answer.text: Upfront SPAN-based margining, daily mark-to-market settlement, online real-time position monitoring, and position limits
Only initial margin collection with no MTM
Risk management only at the monthly level
Self-regulation by brokers without SEBI oversight

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes the risk-containment toolkit as upfront initial margin computed using SPAN, daily mark-to-market settlement of futures positions, online real-time monitoring of member positions by the clearing corporation, and prescribed position limits at client, member, and market level. The Trap: Initial margin alone is not enough — daily MTM, real-time monitoring, and position limits must work together. Monthly-only review or pure broker self-regulation does not meet SEBI's framework. Note: Memorise the quartet: SPAN initial margin, daily MTM, real-time position monitoring, and position limits.
